name: dead-bug-with-plates
instructions:
1. Setup in a supine position with your legs in a 90/90 position (90 degree bend at the hips and knees) and your arms reaching towards the ceiling while holding plates in your hands.
2. Extend the opposite arm and leg simultaneously as you exhale.
3. Return back to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.
4. Repeat for the desired number of total repetitions.
